title: Suno Archive Manager
reported_observation: Public browser extension advertises local export of a user's Suno library, including audio and metadata.
creator_interpretation: Its README describes browser-side capture and ZIP export.
our_hypothesis: Could support private user-owned output archives, but requires permission, code/security review and careful handling of session data.
limitations: Search-result-level capture; full content and linked media not independently audited.
Community claim is not evidence of Suno's private architecture.
Rights, terms, license and data provenance require review.
rights_and_terms: Not assessed. Link to original; do not redistribute code, datasets, audio or full post without permission/compatible license.
access_notes: Public web source. Metadata and summarized observations only.
